D/ IMP ANTONINVS PIVS AVG ; R/ [SVMMVS SACERD]OS AVG

A silver roman denarius of Elagabalus (r.218-222) reece period 10. Probably RIC IV pt2 146, SVMMVS SACERDOS AVG reverse, minted between 221-222AD. Description: Obv.: Laureate, horned & draped bust right. Obv. legend: 'IMP ANTONINVS PIVS AVG'. Rev.: Elagabalus standing left, sacrificing from patera over lit tripod altar, holding branch, star in field left. Rev. legend: '[SVMMVS SACERD]OS AVG'.…
